notes: ROUTING: Werkzeug's <int:goal_id> converter refuses negative values, so no route matches. The app registers a global 404 handler (api/utils/error_handlers.py) so even framework 404s are JSON {"error": "Resource not found"} — NOT the default HTML page. The Rust port must 404 with a JSON error body here; exact message text is not part of the contract, the {error: string} shape is.
